title: Choose the visual world
question: The familiar end, as you asked: three calm directions and the category standard. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: Periwinkle and Coral
options.lineage: The Ultimate Piano's learn view, which you sent, retuned from violet to blue
options.thesis: Your reference's key grammar in a blue-and-coral pair: opposite hues that sit together.
materials: periwinkle scale, coral tonic, pale at rest and full when played
options.viewport: Laptop: step or song in a wide column, choices beside it, the keyboard the full width below; phone: one column, keyboard at the thumb.
options.risk: Closest to the violet you turned down; the blue and the coral have to carry it.

options.label: Engraved Score
options.lineage: printed sheet music: white paper, black engraving, a publisher's red
options.thesis: The app reads like the page on the music stand: ink on white, one red for what you play.
options.viewport: Same wide layout; hairline rules instead of boxes, the chord set large like a title.
options.risk: Austere; chord tones lose their many colours and are told apart by label and one red.

options.label: Songbook Cloth
options.lineage: the cloth-bound church songbook: navy cloth, brick and gold stamping
options.thesis: The songbook's cover colours: navy for action, brick and gold for what the keys mean, on a light page.
options.viewport: Same wide layout; the Path and Songs read like a songbook's contents page.
options.risk: Warm and bookish; kept off cream, it still leans traditional.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What Flowkey, Simply Piano and Skoove ship: white screens, one friendly brand colour, plain keys lit in it.
canonCard.viewport: The layout a learner expects from those three, at their level of craft.
